title: asepalum eriantherum
intro: Asepalum eriantherum, commonly known as Chinese Aristolochia, is a plant species that belongs to the Aristolochiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Asepalum eriantherum include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its medicinal effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include aristolochic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
